description: This Java interface defines data access methods for handling ClobDatatypeStorage objects within the openmrs-core project. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting CLOB storage objects based on identifiers such as id or uuid.

classes.name: DatatypeDAO
classes.description: Java interface for data access object responsible for CRUD operations on ClobDatatypeStorage entities.

methods.name: getClobDatatypeStorage
methods.description: Retrieves a ClobDatatypeStorage object from the database by its integer id.

methods.name: getClobDatatypeStorageByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ClobDatatypeStorage object by its UUID string.

methods.name: saveClobDatatypeStorage
methods.description: Creates or updates a ClobDatatypeStorage object in the database.

methods.name: deleteClobDatatypeStorage
methods.description: Deletes a specified ClobDatatypeStorage object from the database.
